description: Land Acquisition - Kobbewela & Bisowela, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District and two amendments to the Gaz. Ex. Nos. 1630/20, Beliatta D/S Division, and 2068/19, Polagahawela  D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters, including notices of government intent to acquire specific parcels of land for public purposes, descriptions of the lands to be acquired, details about claimants, and amendments to previous land acquisition notices. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" specifically covering "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
